description: Moonee Valley - Stormwater Pipes is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Moonee Valley City Council. This layer contains all Council maintained storm water pipes as line features. It includes pipes and small culverts. Data is maintained on an ad-hoc basis utilising both internal and external sources. Coverage: Moonee Valley City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Moonee Valley City Council. Its tags are Drainage Pipes, stormwater pipe. It offers 1 resource(s) in ESRI SHAPE AND LAYER FILES. The portal shows 2023-06-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
